record.bible_text: The word<WH01697> that the LORD<WH03068> spake<WH01696><WTH8765> against Babylon<WH0894> <FI>and<Fi> against the land<WH0776> of the Chaldeans<WH03778> by<WH03027> Jeremiah<WH03414> the prophet<WH05030>. <RF>by...: Heb. by the hand of Jeremiah<Rf>
